text: This report requests that Community Council consider requests from various event holders for Community Council to declare events municipally significant, and for Council to endorse temporary extensions to licensed hours or areas, for liquor licensing purposes.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated the event listed in Attachment 1 of the report (June 15, 2018) from the City Clerk as municipally significant under Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 27-152, Delegation to Community Councils, and stated that it has no objection to the event.
